proposals: DPIIT and Invest India should tag every India Investment Grid listing as either a discrete project or a scheme or programme, and show the two separately on the flagship list, so that entries like PMGSY and Jal Jeevan Mission are not counted alongside the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor as single investable opportunities.

DPIIT and Invest India should disclose a total value for every one of the 42 sectors on the portal, not only Roads & Highways, Waste & Water and Healthcare, so that opportunity counts can be compared with the capital actually on offer across the whole grid.

The India Investment Grid should add a field naming the central incentive scheme, if any, applicable to each listed opportunity, so that the 22 sectors with 5,088 listings and no identified incentive lane can be confirmed or corrected from the portal itself.

DPIIT should publish the full list of 12,385 opportunities as a downloadable dataset with value, stage, sponsoring agency and project ID, so that researchers no longer need to scrape the portal's charts to check its own headline figures.
